The Directorate General of Taxes launched a three-day workshop on 15 April 2026, supported by AFD's PAGFSI project, to validate the legal framework for fiscal teleprocedures and prepare the progressive rollout of tax e-filing (télédéclaration) and e-payment (télépaiement) under the 2026 finance law.

The Finance Law 2026 (Loi 25-020/AU) inserts articles in the tax procedures book establishing electronic filing and payment of taxes, to be mandatory by tiers for large and medium firms, with the start date to be set by ministerial order.

The Comoros finance ministry, through the AFD-funded PAGF-SI project, called for consultants to study interfacing its tax system SIGIT with the mobile banking platforms of banks and mobile operators, expressions of interest due 28 October 2025.
